sources.title: IIT Kanpur Department of Physics, MSc Lab (PHY 461/462) list of experiments
sources.note: Page fetched and read (41 experiments: Stefan's constant, conductivity of metals, ionic conductivity of alkali halides, superconductor R-T and AC susceptibility, BaTiO3 transition, P-E hysteresis, electro-optic / Kerr, Faraday effect Na + W lamps, CdS photoconductivity, Planck's constant Cs cell, Hall effect and its temperature dependence, magnetoresistance, two hysteresis set-ups, ESR, NMR 12-20 MHz, Zeeman, klystron, Gunn, microwave Bragg, two/four-probe Ge, GM, gamma and beta spectroscopy, Cu characteristic X-rays, Millikan, thermoluminescence, PL lifetime, UNH fluorescence, iodine absorption, Michelson He-Ne and Na, Mach-Zehnder, 2D diffraction, Rowland concave grating).

sources.title: Central University of Kerala, M.Sc. Physics Programme Structure and Syllabus (Revised in 2020), PHY5304 Experimental Physics III
sources.note: PDF text read: GM, scintillation, alpha and gamma detectors, nuclear reaction data analysis; Hall, four probe, band gap, optoelectronic devices, Kerr effect, XRD data analysis, thin film preparation; Zeeman, laser Raman, constant deviation spectrograph, ESR, NMR, ellipsometry.

sources.title: Shri Govind Guru University, Syllabus for M.Sc. Physics (CBCS Programme) Semester 1 and 2, effective June 2023
sources.note: PDF text read: MSC1P109/110 and MSC1P209/210 lists (normal modes, Fourier analysis, e/m helical, Hall, ultrasonic interferometer, transducers, Michelson; graphite conductivity, band gap, SCR, RF oscillator, numerical polynomial roots, four probe, gas-filled photocell; RC amplifier, logic gates, Moon distance by parallax, aerosol spectrometer, solar spectrometer, Stefan's constant, AlO vibrational spectrum, lattice dynamics kit, h by solar cell; GM efficiency, vacuum pump and Gaede's equation, op-amp parameters and amplifiers, ESR, numerical analysis, Quincke's method, X-ray diffraction).

sources.title: Mohanlal Sukhadia University, M.Sc. Physics Semester III Syllabus (NEP) 2024-2025
sources.note: PDF text read: Semiconductor Physics Lab (photo devices, opto-coupler, laser diode NA, fibre bending loss, Malus, Brewster, laser beam profile), Nanoscience Lab (sol-gel, solid state reaction, microwave, hydrothermal, co-precipitation, ball milling, sonochemical, Ag / Au / ZnSe / Fe oxide / Ni / ZnO / CdS / ZnS / PbS), Advance Electronics Lab (analogue computation, microwave bench, fibre TDM and voice links, TV receiver, DSP, robotics, embedded), Radiation Physics Lab (Monte Carlo photon scattering, XCOM, HPGe), Materials Characterization Lab (UV-Vis thin film, AFM, source meter, PL, XRD size/strain/dislocation, TGA, LCR, solar simulator, Compton profile).
